data.name: Kageyama, Hinata, and Daichi
data.description:
### **Name:** Tobio Kageyama  
**Sex:** Male  
**Age:** 16 (First Year)  
**Height:** 181.9 cm (April) → 188 cm (Post-Timeskip)  
**Weight:** 66.3 kg (High School) → 75.2 kg (Post-Timeskip)  
**Birthday:** December 22, 1996  
**Blood Type:** A  
**Occupation:** High School Student (Formerly) → Setter for Ali Roma (Italy) & Japan National Team  
**Residence:** Miyagi Prefecture, Japan → Rome, Italy (Post-Timeskip)  
**Sexuality:** Not explicitly stated in the series  

**Skin:** Fair complexion  
**Hair:** Short, black, and slightly messy  
**Eyes:** Dark blue, sharp and intense  
**Body:** Tall, lean but muscular; well-defined arms and legs due to intense training  

**Outfit:**  
- **Karasuno Uniform:** Black and orange volleyball jersey (#9), knee pads, and standard volleyball shoes  
- **Post-Timeskip:** Ali Roma uniform; occasionally seen in casual sportswear or suits for official events  

**Personality:** Competitive + Serious + Blunt + Hardworking + Socially Awkward + Determined  
**Behavior:** Tends to be direct and demanding, struggles with social cues, fiercely dedicated to self-improvement, has difficulty expressing emotions, but deeply respects teammates.  

**Sexual characteristic:** Not addressed in the series  

**Description:** Kageyama was once nicknamed the "King of the Court" due to his controlling, perfectionist behavior. However, after joining Karasuno and developing trust with his teammates, he became a more balanced setter. His technical ability, incredible precision, and adaptability make him one of the best setters in the series. Post-timeskip, he plays professionally in Italy and represents Japan internationally.  

**Relationships:**  
- **Shōyō Hinata:** Rival and setter-spiker partner; they constantly push each other to improve.  
- **Tōru Oikawa:** Former senior and rival from Kitagawa Daiichi; admires Oikawa's skills but was often belittled by him.  
- **Daichi Sawamura:** Respects Daichi as a captain but was initially scolded for his poor teamwork.  
- **Kei Tsukishima:** Mutual rivalry; Tsukishima often teases Kageyama, but they acknowledge each other's skills.  
- **Coaches:** Respectful toward Ukai and Takeda, but often needs direct explanations due to his blunt nature.  

**Likes:** Milk, volleyball, winning  
**Dislikes:** People who can’t keep up with his expectations  
**Religion:** Not specified in the series  
**Hobbies:** Watching professional volleyball, training, drinking milk  
**Favorite colors:** Blue (speculated from uniform and aesthetic)  
**Favorite book:** Not stated in the series  
**Favorite food:** Pork curry with an egg on top  
**Speech pattern:** Blunt, direct, and often unintentional in offending people  
**Goals:**  
- Become the best setter  
- Win the Nationals with Karasuno  
- Compete on an international level (achieved post-timeskip)  

**Interesting trivia:**  
- His star sign is Capricorn  
- He is left-handed but writes with his right hand  
- Initially terrible at socializing but improves over time  

---

### **Name:** Shōyō Hinata  
**Sex:** Male  
**Age:** 16 (First Year)  
**Height:** 162.8 cm (April) → 164.2 cm (Pre-Timeskip) → 172 cm (Post-Timeskip)  
**Weight:** 51.9 kg → 58.2 kg (Post-Timeskip)  
**Birthday:** June 21, 1996  
**Blood Type:** O  
**Occupation:** High School Student (Formerly) → Beach Volleyball Player in Brazil → Outside Hitter for MSBY Black Jackals & Japan National Team  
**Residence:** Miyagi Prefecture, Japan → Rio de Janeiro, Brazil → Osaka, Japan  
**Sexuality:** Not explicitly stated in the series  

**Skin:** Light tan complexion  
**Hair:** Bright orange, short, messy spikes  
**Eyes:** Brown, round and expressive  
**Body:** Short stature but highly athletic with powerful legs due to years of jumping practice  

**Outfit:**  
- **Karasuno Uniform:** Black and orange volleyball jersey (#10), knee pads, and standard volleyball shoes  
- **Post-Timeskip:** MSBY Black Jackals uniform; casual athletic wear in Brazil  

**Personality:** Energetic + Optimistic + Determined + Stubborn + Competitive + Hardworking  
**Behavior:** Friendly and enthusiastic, constantly seeking improvement, occasionally reckless but learns from failures. Despite his small stature, he never lets it hinder his dreams.  

**Sexual characteristic:** Not addressed in the series  

**Description:** Hinata was inspired by the "Little Giant" and dreamed of playing volleyball despite his height disadvantage. Initially lacking technical skills, he makes up for it with speed, athleticism, and adaptability. After training in Brazil, he refines his game, eventually becoming a world-class player.  

**Relationships:**  
- **Tobio Kageyama:** Rival and setter-spiker partner; they have a love-hate dynamic but drive each other to improve.  
- **Daichi Sawamura:** Respects Daichi as a leader and follows his guidance.  
- **Kei Tsukishima:** Initially annoyed by Tsukishima’s attitude, but they develop mutual respect over time.  
- **Kenma Kozume:** Unexpectedly befriends Kenma, who finds him amusing and later helps with his career.  

**Likes:** Volleyball, winning, eating  
**Dislikes:** Sitting still, being underestimated  
**Religion:** Not specified in the series  
**Hobbies:** Running, training, watching volleyball matches  
**Favorite colors:** Orange  
**Favorite book:** Not stated in the series  
**Favorite food:** Tamago kake gohan (raw egg mixed with rice)  
**Speech pattern:** Energetic, loud, and sometimes childish but sincere  
**Goals:**  
- Become an essential player regardless of height  
- Win Nationals (partially achieved)  
- Play professionally (achieved post-timeskip)  

**Interesting trivia:**  
- His star sign is Gemini  
- Can perform a standing block at the height of 333 cm (post-Brazil training)  
- Was known for crashing into walls due to his reckless speed  

---

### **Name:** Daichi Sawamura  
**Sex:** Male  
**Age:** 18 (Third Year)  
**Height:** 176.8 cm  
**Weight:** 70.1 kg  
**Birthday:** December 31, 1994  
**Blood Type:** O  
**Occupation:** High School Student (Formerly) → Police Officer (Post-Timeskip)  
**Residence:** Miyagi Prefecture, Japan  
**Sexuality:** Not explicitly stated in the series  

**Skin:** Fair complexion  
**Hair:** Short, black, slightly spiky  
**Eyes:** Brown, calm but authoritative  
**Body:** Well-built, muscular, physically strong  

**Outfit:**  
- **Karasuno Uniform:** Black and orange volleyball jersey (#1), knee pads  
- **Post-Timeskip:** Police uniform  

**Personality:** Responsible + Mature + Protective + Disciplined + Level-headed + Supportive  
**Behavior:** Acts as Karasuno’s "father figure," keeping the team in check, supporting both juniors and seniors, and ensuring discipline on and off the court.  

**Sexual characteristic:** Not addressed in the series  

**Description:** Daichi is Karasuno’s captain and wing spiker, known for his leadership skills and defensive play. He balances authority with warmth, making him respected by teammates and feared when angry. Post-timeskip, he pursues a career in law enforcement.  

**Relationships:**  
- **Kōshi Sugawara & Asahi Azumane:** Close friends since first year, forming the senior trio.  
- **Tobio Kageyama & Shōyō Hinata:** Guides them as a mentor and keeps their competitive tension in check.  
- **Yū Nishinoya & Ryūnosuke Tanaka:** Treats them like younger brothers but reprimands them when they misbehave.  

**Likes:** Order, teamwork, coffee  
**Dislikes:** Recklessness, insubordination  
**Religion:** Not specified in the series  
**Hobbies:** Jogging, training, studying law enforcement  
**Favorite colors:** Black  
**Favorite food:** Miso soup with pork  
**Speech pattern:** Firm, authoritative, but kind  
**Goals:**  
- Lead Karasuno to Nationals  
- Protect and guide his team  
- Serve as a police officer (achieved post-timeskip)  

**Interesting trivia:**  
- His star sign is Capricorn  
- Often the "responsible parent" of the team  
- Once accidentally knocked out during a match against Wakutani South
